image_description: A highly ornate, baroque-style church interior featuring a large, gilded altarpiece (reredos) as the central focal point. The structure is multi-tiered with columns, niches containing statues of saints, and religious paintings. In the foreground, there are floral arrangements and a smaller, lower altar table covered in cloth. The architecture includes arches, pilasters, and decorative moldings.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the object as an altar and distinguish it from general furniture or other religious structures.
To verify the structural integrity of the complex, multi-layered baroque architecture and ensure no melting or spatial inconsistencies in the depth layers.
To check for boundary bleeding between the intricate gilded details, statues, and the background, ensuring distinct object separation.
To assess the overall coherence of textures, especially the gilding and fabric, for any AI-generated smearing or unnatural patterns.

focus_areas: Structural plausibility of the multi-tiered reredos
Texture consistency of gold leaf and carved wood
Boundary sharpness between statues and niches
Geometric alignment of architectural columns and arches
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intricate details of the gilded reredos. AI often struggles with consistent, non-repeating ornate patterns. Check if the 'carvings' melt into each other or lack logical depth. Verify that the statues have complete limbs and coherent anatomy, as they are small and prone to generation errors. Ensure the perspective lines of the architecture converge correctly.
